name: Forge Group, Inc.
summary: Operating within the United States, Forge Group, Inc. is a property and casualty insurer with a focus on commercial automobile policies. It specifically covers vehicles for hire, including taxi cabs, sedans, and other light transportation services. Furthermore, the company maintains a real estate portfolio, owning and leasing three commercial properties located in the District of Columbia. Forge Group, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Chevy Chase, Maryland.
